p1: Nine hikers cut their tent open from the inside... and ran into the snow without boots.
Ten skiers set out. One fell sick and turned back. He was the only one who came home.
The other nine camped on a slope the Mansi call Dead Mountain.
Weeks later, searchers found the tent. Their boots were still inside.
The first bodies lay near the trees, by a small fire. Some in just their underwear.
The last four weren't found until months later.
One had a fractured skull. Two, crushed chests. Their clothes had traces of radiation.
The Soviet verdict: a compelling natural force.
In 2019, Russia reopened the case and blamed an avalanche.
But what made nine people cut their way out... into the dark? Nobody knows for sure.
